summary: Trypsin-chymotrypsin is an oral proteolytic enzyme combination used as adjunctive therapy to reduce inflammation, edema and swelling associated with trauma, surgery, and soft-tissue injury, and to aid wound healing. A common regimen is one enteric-coated tablet (e.g. 100,000 Armour units) 3-4 times daily before meals. It is not FDA-approved.
indications: Adjunctive reduction of post-traumatic and postoperative inflammation and edema
Aid to resolution of inflammation and promotion of wound healing
Adjunct in abscesses, hematomas and inflammatory conditions

dosage.d: 1 enteric-coated tablet (~100,000 Armour units) 3-4 times daily
dosage.n: Take on empty stomach; course usually limited to a few days

admin: Swallow enteric-coated tablets whole on an empty stomach, about 30 minutes before meals
Do not crush or chew (enteric coating protects enzymes from gastric acid)
Use as a short adjunctive course alongside definitive treatment
moa: Trypsin and chymotrypsin are proteolytic enzymes that hydrolyze peptide bonds. Orally, they are thought to act systemically after absorption to break down inflammatory exudates and fibrin, reduce edema, and facilitate drainage and resolution of inflammation, supporting tissue repair.

absolute: Known hypersensitivity to trypsin, chymotrypsin or proteolytic enzymes

preg: Avoid - safety in pregnancy has not been established; use only if clearly necessary.
lact: Avoid during breastfeeding due to insufficient safety data.
renal: No specific dose adjustment described; avoid in severe renal disease.
hepatic: Use with caution; avoid in severe hepatic disease (limited data).

moderate: Other anti-inflammatory enzyme preparations - additive effect
interactions.food: Take on an empty stomach before meals; food reduces absorption.

monitoring: Clinical resolution of edema and inflammation
Signs of bleeding if on anticoagulants
counsel: Swallow the tablet whole on an empty stomach about 30 minutes before food
Do not crush or chew the tablet
Stop and seek care if you develop a rash, itching or swelling
Use only for the short course your doctor advises
Tell your doctor if you take blood thinners
pk: Anti-inflammatory effect over hours to days
Store in a cool, dry place, protect from moisture and heat
pearls: Oral proteolytic enzyme used only as an adjunct for swelling/inflammation, not a primary therapy
Enteric coating is essential - never crush or chew the tablet
Take on an empty stomach to maximize absorption
Theoretical bleeding risk - use caution with anticoagulants and around surgery
missed: Take the missed dose when remembered unless it is nearly time for the next dose; do not double up. Resume the regular schedule.
overdose: Overdose data are limited; large amounts may cause GI upset or allergic symptoms. Management is supportive; discontinue the drug and treat any hypersensitivity reaction.
